reviews.title: Super Fast!
reviews.comment: The G.SKILL Trident Z5 RGB Series is an exceptional memory kit that combines top-tier performance with stunning aesthetics. Its sleek design and customizable RGB lighting make it a standout component in any build, while its blazing-fast speeds and excellent stability ensure optimal performance for gaming, content creation, and multitasking. The heat spreader not only looks premium but also keeps temperatures in check during heavy workloads. Installation is straightforward, and it integrates seamlessly with major motherboard RGB software for synchronized lighting effects. For those seeking reliable, high-performance RAM with a touch of flair, the Trident Z5 RGB Series is an outstanding choice.
reviews.author: C Tucker 0321

reviews.title: Solid RAM and Solid Support
reviews.comment: Without Lights: These sticks perform great. Installing them is easy and the build quality is fantastic. G.Skill customer support is great. I initially had issues with the XMP profile, and when I called their support line, an *actual human* picked up the phone and walked me through troubleshooting. If they had a quick note inside the box about XMP/EXPO and how to diagnose any issues, that might help, but I'm still very satisfied with the support I received. I haven't tried overclocking the RAM further than the 6000MHz or tightening timings beyond the 36-36-36-96; I'll update if I do. With RGB: The G.Skill software is pretty barebones, and it notes that it might interfere with other RGB software. There aren't any settings for alternating between two colors or two brightnesses with a breathing mode, which is a shame. I also saw that the sticks aren't exactly in sync with one another if you do any moving patterns that are supposed to be synchronized, which is jarring. That being said, I wanted white without any movement, and that is what I was able to do, very easily. I also don't have to keep the app running in order to keep the lighting effect which is very nice. All said: I would give 4.5 stars because of the first party RGB software, but since I don't have any other software to try with it, I'm completely satisfied.

reviews.title: Excellent for Mid-Range PC Build
reviews.comment: Pro Speed. Compatibility. Con Price. Conclusion I've purchased G.SKILL Ram before the RAM inflation and I'm glad I did. The cost for 2x16GB was 115USD. My PC setup had not shown any sign of slowing down even on multiple application windows. The RAM is computable with GIGABYTE B660I AORUS PRO and ASUS ROG Strix B760-I with midrange build. But the price for it now is steep but it will hold up around 3 - 5 years.
